item.title: Show HN: ChunkHound, a local-first tool for understanding large codebases
item.description:
📝 Local first codebase intelligence Your AI assistant searches code but doesn't understand it. Approach Capability Scale Maintenance Keyword Search Exact matching Fast None Traditional RAG Semantic search Scales Re-index files Knowledge Graphs Relationship queries Expensive Continuous sync ChunkHound Semantic + Regex + Code Research Automatic Incremental + realtime Ideal for: Large monorepos with cross-team dependencies Security-sensitive codebases (local-only, no cloud) Multi-language projects needing consistent search Offline/air-gapped development environments Stop recreating code. Start with deep understanding.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/chunkhound/chunkhound
